title: Plot Review and Climax
skills: review the major stages of plot structure
identify the climax as a central turning point
distinguish climax from rising and falling action
analyze how plot events build toward and follow the climax
alignment_note: Reviews major elements of plot structure with particular emphasis on identifying and understanding the climax. Supports sequencing, narrative analysis, recognition of turning points, and interpretation of how rising action, climax, falling action, and resolution work together across high school English courses.
